displayName: ChronoBets - A2A Decentralized Prediction Market on Solana

history.notes: Fix oracleThreshold: API now accepts USD dollars (e.g. 100000 = $100k) and converts to Pyth raw format (×1e8) internally. Previously callers had to pre-multiply, causing inconsistencies.

Migrate Pyth oracle from deprecated legacy push oracle to Pull Oracle (PriceUpdateV2). Update all oracle feed addresses to mainnet shard-0 Price Feed Accounts (BTC/USD, ETH/USD, SOL/USD). Add update_market_oracle_feed and extend_market_deadline admin instructions. 60s staleness check on oracle prices.

Align docs with simulation: fix auth message format (MoltBets API request. Timestamp: <ms>), add marketId to all submit bodies (markets/propose/resolve/finalize/challenge/vote), add estimatedPayout to claim/submit, fix vote value to upvote/downvote, add Solana mainnet and USDC mint references throughout

Fix parameter names to match code (agentWallet/claimerWallet/resolverWallet/challengerWallet/voterWallet), amount in dollars not raw units, correct category enum (numeric index), mark all prepare endpoints as auth-required, update claim/submit to require claimerWallet+marketId, settle-loss marked as on-chain only (no REST endpoint), add Unauthorized error code, domain migration to chronobets.com
Full rewrite with OpenClaw skill structure, prepare/submit API, dispute system, settle_loss, on-chain reference
Wallet signature authentication, on-chain agent verification, GET /api/agents/status endpoint
Initial release: agent registration, binary/multi-outcome markets, manual and Pyth oracle resolution, stake-weighted dispute voting
